description: Approved Asset Store packs for the props layer. source asset_store requires a real file; without it the entry stays pending and is never instanced. European City buildings are excluded so they cannot replace OSM footprints. Vehicles stay static and need parking evidence.

packs.name: Mobile Optimize Free Low Poly Cars
packs.license_text: Standard Unity Asset Store EULA (Appendix 1, 2024-12-04). Embed in a Licensed Product with substantial original content. Do not redistribute the .unitypackage or train AI on the assets.

packs.name: Low Poly European City Pack
packs.license_text: Standard Unity Asset Store EULA (Appendix 1, 2024-12-04). Furniture only: benches, lamps, fences, signs. Buildings and road tiles are excluded so they cannot replace OSM geometry.
